snippet.title: CloverPit Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
CloverPit is the demonic lovechild of Balatro and Buckshot Roulette from Indie studio Panik Arcade (maker of the fan favourite Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom) and publisher Future Friends Games (The Cabin Factory, SUMMERHOUSE, Exo One). This slot machine horror will be out on Steam on the 3rd of September!

About the game:
CloverPit locks you in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, in which players must pay off their debt or fall to ruin – literally. Manipulate the slot machine to earn extra coins. Turn the odds in your favor with various prizes and charms that trigger big big combos, snowballing into a dazzling lucky run. Bend the rules, break the game, and pay off your debts!

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3314790/CloverPit/
Trailer by Franck Besançon
Music composed by Clement Panchout
